trailhead.label: Val d’Amola car park, the APT’s start

cautions: Rocky mountain path and granite slabs above 2,000 m.
Wooden bridge over the fast Sarca d’Amola.
No shelter from bad weather on the ridge.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Val d’Amola car park, the APT’s start: Parcheggio della Val d’Amola, la partenza indicata dall'APT
textIt.Rocky mountain path and granite slabs ab: Sentiero di montagna roccioso e placche di granito oltre i 2.000 m.
textIt.Wooden bridge over the fast Sarca d’Amol: Ponte di legno sull'impetuoso Sarca d’Amola.
textIt.No shelter from bad weather on the ridge: Nessun riparo dal maltempo sulla cresta.
